promoCards.title: Spore: Nascent Hive
powers: Search your deck for a Mind card and put it into your hand or in play. If you put it into play, {Spore} deals itself 2 toxic damage.

promoCards.title: Spore: Seed of Vengeance
powers: The next time a hero is dealt damage by a non-hero target, {Spore} deals that target 1 melee damage. [b]Beast:[/b] Increase damage dealt this way by 2. [b]Mind:[/b] Change the damage type to psychic and reduce damage dealt by the source of the triggering damage by 1 until the start of {Spore}'s next turn.

cards.title: Spore
powers: Draw a card. [b]Beast:[/b] {Spore} deals 1 target 1 melee damage and 1 toxic damage. [b]Mind:[/b] up to 2 other heroes may each draw a card.

cards.title: Behavior Modulation
body: Draw 2 cards. [b]Beast:[/b] Search your deck for a Mind card and put it into your hand or in play. [b]Mind:[/b] Search your deck for a Beast card and put it into your hand or in play.

cards.title: Bladed Tendrils
body: When a Mind card enters play, destroy this card. Activate [b]Beast[/b] effects. Increase melee damage dealt by {Spore} by 1. The first time {Spore} deals each target melee damage each turn, {Spore} deals that target 1 toxic damage.
powers: {Spore} deals up to 2 targets 1 melee damage each.

cards.title: Choking Spores
body: When a Mind card enters play, destroy this card. Activate [b]Beast[/b] effects. Increase toxic damage dealt by {Spore} by 1. The first time each target deals damage to {Spore} each turn, {Spore} deals that target 0 toxic damage. Reduce the next damage dealt by a target dealt damage this way by 1.

cards.title: Colossal Leap
body: {Spore} deals 1 target 3 melee damage. [b]Beast:[/b] Redirect the next damage dealt by that target to {Spore}. [b]Mind:[/b] Prevent the next damage dealt to {Spore}.

cards.title: Empathic Relay
body: When a Beast card enters play, destroy this card. Activate [b]Mind[/b] effects. Reduce psychic damage dealt to heroes by 1. The second time each turn a hero draws a card, one other hero may draw a card.

cards.title: Mental Motivator
body: When a Beast card enters play, destroy this card. Activate [b]Mind[/b] effects. Increase psychic damage dealt by heroes by 1.
powers: One hero other than {Spore} deals 1 target 2 psychic damage.

cards.title: Monstrous Guardian
body: When a Mind card enters play, destroy this card. Activate [b]Beast[/b] effects. Reduce damage dealt to {Spore} by 1. The first time each turn another hero would be dealt damage by a non-hero target, you may redirect that damage to {Spore}

cards.title: Neural Blast
body: {Spore} deals 1 target 2 psychic damage. [b]Mind:[/b] Each other hero deals that target 1 psychic damage. [b]Beast:[/b] That target deals 1 other target 3 melee damage.

cards.title: Nutrient Absorption
body: You may destroy a non-target environment or hero ongoing card. If a card is destroyed this way, [b]Beast:[/b] {Spore} deals up to 3 targets 2 toxic damage each. [b]Mind:[/b] {Spore} gains 2 HP and you may draw a card.

cards.title: Photosynthesis
body: {Spore} gains 1 HP. Draw a card. [b]Beast:[/b] {Spore} deals 1 target 1 toxic damage. [b]Mind:[/b] One other hero gains 1 HP.

cards.title: Psychic Stimulation
body: One other hero draws 2 cards. [b]Beast:[/b] Increase damage dealt to and by that hero by 1 until the start of your next turn. [b]Mind: [/b]reduce damage dealt to and by that hero by 1 until the start of your next turn.

cards.title: Rapid Growth
body: {Spore} deals 1 target 2 toxic damage. [b]Beast:[/b] Reveal cards from your deck until a Beast card is revealed and put it into play. Shuffle the other revealed cards into your deck. [b]Mind:[/b] Reveal cards from your deck until a Mind card is revealed and put it into play. Shuffle the other revealed cards into your deck.

cards.title: Root Barrier
body: Reduce the next damage dealt to {Spore} by 2. [b]Beast:[/b] The next time {Spore} is dealt damage, it deals the source of that damage 2 toxic damage. [b]Mind:[/b] {Spore} gains 3 HP.

cards.title: Sensory Spores
body: When a Beast card enters play, destroy this card. Activate [b]Mind[/b] effects. Reduce the first damage dealt to {Spore} each turn by 2.
powers: Reveal and replace the top card of a deck. Draw a card.

cards.title: Tanglevine
body: {Spore} deals 1 target 2 melee damage. [b]Beast:[/b] Until the start of your next turn, whenever that target deals damage, {Spore} deals that target 1 toxic damage.[b] Mind: [/b]prevent the next damage dealt by that target.

cards.title: Vise Grip
body: Select a target. Until the end of your next turn, redirect damage dealt by {Spore} to that target. [b]Beast:[/b] {Spore} deals that target 2 melee damage. [b]Mind:[/b] You may use an extra power during your power phase.
